'''Championships''' are the Star Wars CCG World Championships: Decipher's from 1996 to 2001 and the [[Players Committee]]'s from 2002 on. Each year has a hub page with the location, field, top cut and sourced decklists.

How the circuit was run (Swiss, ratings, decklist sheets): [[Tournaments]]. Event index: [[List of SWCCG tournaments]]. European Championship years: [[European Championships]]. Blank-name sheets: [[Unknown players]].

The 1999 event was at [[DecipherCon 1999]] in Virginia Beach. The 2000 event was at [[DecipherCon 2000]] in Kissimmee, Florida, with surviving official photographs and the Final Confrontation video on that page. The 2002 event was at [[DecipherCon 2002]] in Chesapeake, Virginia. Playtest and travel groups are on [[Star Wars CCG teams]].
